Duplicate source PMIDs were reused only where the same verified comparison applied to closely related worklist topics. Each new entry has a numeric intervention-versus-control result or valid relative effect, Korean subjects, and a mapped prescription-drug category. Four topics were rejected because verified ClinicalTrials.gov/PubMed evidence did not provide an eligible numeric comparator effect: thiotepa Myelodysplastic Syndrome, thiotepa Germ Cell Tumors, botulinum toxin Crow's Feet, and canakinumab Gout.
